description: Synthetic sesslint.adapters.claude_code parity (prefix helpers, detection, loader seams, and documented line-processor gaps).
known_parity_gaps: GAP-claude-secret-scan-tracker: _load_claude_code_internal stops at sesslint.checks.hygiene.SecretScanTracker for bytes and streams. Rust does not construct the tracker. The harness asserts that seam and does not treat pin success as equal to the seam.
GAP-claude-open-byte-source: a path that passes stat checks stops at sesslint.adapters.claude_code._open_byte_source. Rust does not read the file or construct SecretScanTracker on that arm.
GAP-claude-session-envelope: load_claude_code_session calls _load_claude_code_internal only. Rust does not build a Session envelope.
GAP-claude-line-fingerprint: _process_claude_line stops at the fingerprint codec when make_finding would run in the pin. Findings are not appended.

GAP-claude-line-canonical: a classified record that would reach sha256(canonical_bytes(obj)) stops at sesslint._canonical_codec.canonical_json_bytes. Events the pin would append after that hash are not appended.
GAP-claude-line-secret-feed: _process_claude_line with a supplied secret_tracker stops at SecretScanTracker.feed. Rust returns the tracker seam without scanning.
